purpose: Resolve first twelve evidence-priority Weiser practices against printed original pages, retain regional and ritual qualifications, and correct source pointers without overwriting inherited research IDs.
notes: The source image itself is the original primary witness for the limited described action; scanned source excerpts are paraphrased, not fully reproduced.
No original pages or complete 28-chapter text are being certified exhaustively.
Weiser's 1958 reports can describe pre-Christian practices; historical report does not imply Catholic endorsement or continuous practice.
A different parish source may record an identically named but distinct local Advent custom.
Page-number corrections are append-only: leave original source registry IDs intact until downstream crosswalk reconciliation.
Source-supported historical occasion is not the same as a current parish event. Fixed Gregorian hints are restricted to the historically reported Latin-context cases.
